podcast.body: This song is featured on The Network's one and only album, Money Money 2020, released in 2003. The track serves as an example of the band's music, which is slightly different from Green Day's typical style, further fueling speculation about The Network being Green Day's pseudonymous project. "The song is Rocham Bo from the one and only network album Money Money 2020 from 2003."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
